Name: the barber shop. Style: Fades, classic cuts, beards and hot towel shaves. Town: Nottingham, 22 Hockley Row (example), Nottingham NG1.
Hours: Sunday: 10am till 3pm. Tuesday and Wednesday and Friday: 9am till 6pm. Thursday: 9am till 8pm. Saturday: 8am till 5pm. Closed Mondays.
Free to cancel or move with 72 hours' notice.
Walk-ins: welcome when a chair is free. Kids: kids' price under 12; under-16s with an adult.

Access: Step-free from the street, with room for a wheelchair at every chair. Ask for a quiet time and we will book one. Parking: There's no parking at the shop: the Lace Market and Victoria Centre car parks are a few minutes' walk. Products: We sell the wax, clay, oils and beard balm we use in the shop. Tips: Tips are welcome, and the barbers keep all of them. Jobs: We're always happy to hear from barbers and apprentices: drop your details in, or leave a message. Home visits: We don't do home visits.
